events.name: Qi Surge
events.description: The province's meridians swell, and every breath carries a storm's worth of Qi.

events.name: Grand Market Fair
events.description: Traders from three circuits crowd the stalls, undercutting one another and paying over the odds.

events.name: Beast Tide
events.description: Something in the wilds has broken. Beasts press against the market road in numbers not seen in a generation.

events.name: Forge Conclave
events.description: Smiths and alchemists set their benches in the square and judge every finished work aloud.

events.name: Rift Convergence
events.description: The hidden realms drift into alignment. For a little while, no rift will refuse a seeker.

events.name: Ancestral Resonance
events.description: Old altars answer before they are asked. Legacies held in them give their challengers more time.

events.name: Grand Sect Assembly
events.description: The twelve houses send delegates to the market. Service done in the sect's name is counted twice.

events.name: Crimson Rain
events.description: Blood-warm rain falls without clouds. Cultivation quickens, and the beasts grow bold beneath it.
